target_customer: AI labs buying formal verification RL environments and coding data
problem: AI models are weak at formal verification of chips and critical software. Repovive supplies formalization RL environments and coding data to improve them.
business_model: Contracts and data licensing to AI labs
product_category: RL environments and training data for formal verification

founders.name: Shayan Chashm Jahan
education: University of Maryland, PhD in computer science
founders.background_notes: YC page lists National Informatics Olympiad gold, ICPC World Finalist, Codeforces International Grandmaster, NeurIPS and ICLR publications, and a 33,000 subscriber algorithms YouTube channel.

founders.name: Amir Mostafavi
education: UT Austin, MS in human-computer interaction
UT Austin, BS in computer science

competitors.name: Cajal Technologies
competitors.what: Verified math data and RL environments in Lean 4, Coq and Isabelle for frontier labs

competitors.name: Axiom
competitors.what: Formal reasoning company mentioned as having raised $200M, product details not verified

technical_complexity.rationale: Building formalization environments needs deep expertise in proof assistants and verification; the team cites NeurIPS, ICLR and IJCAI papers and olympiad medalists.

defensibility.rationale: A 12,000 member medalist community is a talent pipeline for data creation, but buyers are a few labs who can build in-house, and competitors like Cajal sell the same product.

market_need_then: Labs were spending heavily on RL environments in 2026; the company says it holds $100k in contracts across two formalization environments and a $200k letter of intent, per its YC description (self-reported).

branding.domain_note: Uses repovive.com for contests and research.repovive.com for the company site.
branding.brand_signature: Repovive Premier and Standard Codeforces rounds drawing a competitive-programming community
branding.community_and_virality: Runs rated rounds on Codeforces (Premier Round 4, Testing Round 2) and claims a community of 12,000 IMO, IOI and ICPC medalists.

brand_strength.rationale: Known in competitive-programming circles through Codeforces rounds, but the name is unrelated to formal verification and the company brand is new.

outcome_analysis: Repovive started as a competitive programming contest community and entered Fall 2026 selling formal verification RL environments to labs. Early contracts are self-reported and competitors already sell similar data, so durability depends on the talent community. No outcome yet.
notes: The research.repovive.com site returned a 403 and was not read; company details come from the YC page. Founding year unknown. Funding searches found no coverage of any round. The contest-to-lab-data shift is inferred from the contest brand and the YC description and is not a sourced pivot. Competition is as of the Fall 2026 batch; Cajal source is dated March 2026. Axiom detail is from a weak commentary source.
